newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk talking to CSX about Conrail offers.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk talking to CSX about Conrail offers.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp said Monday that it is talking with CSX Corp about their respective offers to acquire Conrail Inc.
"The basis for NS's participation in these discussions is its commitment to provide strong competitive service in the East for rail customers," Norfolk said in a release.

Norfolk Southern has been vying with CSX to acquire Philadelpha-based Conrail. Last week Norfolk sued to block CSX's proposed $8.4 billion merger with Conrail, after launching an unsolicited $100 cash per share bid for Conrail.
